person_note: The controlling narration is third person, with focalization shifting among Anne, Neely, and Jennifer rather than a change in grammatical person. Extended Goodreads passages independently show external she-based scene narration and close access to characters’ perceptions; the publisher opening and an interior Jennifer extract agree, while the whole-book POV description explicitly says all narration remains third person. First-person and second-person forms in the quote set are dialogue, prayer, maxims, or generic/free-indirect “you,” not autonomous base sections. Some popular quotes are clipped or too aphoristic to diagnose individually, but no credible evidence suggests first-person, second-person, or alternating base narration.
